known_limitations: gas screen assumes ~4 near contacts; open frameworks (ReO3, cuprite) lose their majority sublattice before the descriptor sees them
the 24-control Phase-4 panel is measuring centre-convention mismatch, not detector quality, and must be rebuilt before it can inform anything

score depends on domain size (corr(log n_centres, log score) = -0.591); a size-conditioned threshold is implemented and has the most stable decisions (flip fraction 0.0061) but a higher known FPR (0.08)
tested on three well-separated families; the crowded 4-5 family regime where sequential expansion saw known-FPR rise 0.09 -> 0.36 is NOT covered here
